about: The two variants of the FFX voice recordings (Tidus, Yuna, Auron), read by tools/audio/voice-variant.mjs. Bailey has not picked between them (2026-10-07). Folders live outside the repo; a variant is staged as hard links so voice-ship.mjs sees <id>.mp3.

tight.label: pauses shortened
tight.about: The 203 recordings with the 81 over-long inner pauses shortened (<id>.tight.mp3 in the listening folder); the other 122 are the originals. The only variant that passes the ship gate by itself.

recorded.label: as recorded
recorded.about: The 203 recordings exactly as returned. 81 of them hold a pause over 400 ms, which the ship gate fails; this variant installs them with those findings accepted (the ids are listed under accepted in the ship report).
